INSERT INTO script_snapshots_meta (script_id, content_snapshot, snapshot_format, created_at, last_snapshot_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW(), NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (script_id) 
        DO UPDATE SET 
            content_snapshot = $2,
            snapshot_format = $3,
            created_at = NOW(),
            last_snapshot_at = NOW()
